definitions.ask: When the note field is empty, should other payees' notes fill the list after this payee's own notes?
definitions.why: one rule on every row; this payee's notes still lead, so nothing it already finds moves down

choices.label: Every row shows up to 4 notes, this payee's first and then other payees' most-used recent notes
Other payees' notes appear only when this payee has none of its own

definitions.ask: On an empty field, should the faint ghost text preview the top note even when it came from another payee?
definitions.why: a ghost reads as "this is probably it", which an unrelated payee's note is not

choices.label: Only this payee's own notes ghost; new payees keep the "What was this for?" placeholder
The top note always ghosts, so the placeholder disappears on every row that has suggestions
